title: Contractive Matrix Decomposition
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $A$ be a symmetric real $n\times n$ matrix with nonnegative entries and every row summing to $1$. Let $\lambda(A)$ be the supremum of $\|Av\|$ over unit vectors $v$ orthogonal to the constant vector with every coordinate $1/n$, and suppose $\lambda(A)\leq \lambda$ for some $\lambda\geq 0$. Then there is a real $n\times n$ matrix $C$ such that $A=(1-\lambda)J+\lambda C$, where every entry of $J$ is $1/n$, and the Euclidean operator norm of $C$ is at most $1$.
